node/11640842891.summary: Cooperative meeting place with a fully vegan eetcafé, makers' market and coworking, opened after a four-year run-up and crowdfunding.

node/11897518892.summary: All-day café-bar in the former The Cover on the Vrijdagmarkt: newspaper and coffee by day, dinner (mains up to €17.50) and late drinks at night.

node/13685423940.summary: Mediterranean-coast mezze and grill restaurant near the Citadelpark.

node/13296111878.summary: Alberte's little-sister café and cave: natural wines, small plates, pizza and pasta, as happy to serve a cola as a €200 bottle.

node/13306301095.summary: Traditional Gazan dishes cooked 'the way our mother made them' near the Dampoort.

node/13510617308.summary: Afghan restaurant in the Brugse Poort with rice and grill dishes such as qabuli palaw, plus traditional floor seating.

node/11157734893.summary: No-nonsense natural wine bar and bottle shop by the Belfry, also pouring wild-fermented beers and ciders, with good music and soirées hosted by winemakers.

node/12574625746.summary: Natural wine bar near the Gravensteen with brunch, a cellar, a bottle shop and a B&B upstairs; oysters at €1 on the first Sunday.

node/5734799243.summary: 'Bar à manger' pairing seasonal bistronomic plates (oysters are a staple) with a curated natural wine list; listed by Gault&Millau.

node/9248442976.summary: Wine bar and delicatessen on the Groentenmarkt pairing small-estate wines with artisan cheeses and charcuterie; everything is also for sale.

node/12992514757.summary: Chef Bert and sommelier Caroline's wine bistro on the Kraanlei: a short seasonal menu built on pure products and a broad, natural-leaning wine list.
